final_rationale: The verdict changes because the Actor materially narrowed the claim being defended; no new admissible evidence was provided. On the same record, the Actor now aligns with the policy by conceding that clean certification is not supported and that the most the record can support is a caveated position tied to disclosure of the unresolved underwriting limitation. That narrowed position is supportable from admissible evidence: aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, the underwriting slice remains below target, the mitigation is still draft, and policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. This is enough for compliant_with_caveats as an audit characterization of the Actor's final position, but not enough for unqualified compliance because the compliance predicate is still unresolved in the underlying launch record until disclosure is actually corrected or risk acceptance is approved.
